object_description: two-storey counterpart hall overlapping the existing one, with a large forecourt at the overlap
geometry_property: differentiated opening behaviour on all facades
column-free span over hall and entrance
design_condition: the new hall is arranged as an overlapping counterpart to the existing one so that a large forecourt and the main entrance sit in the overlap area, forming a balanced ensemble of public uses

positive: The two buildings form a balanced ensemble of public uses in a heterogeneous residential area
A large forecourt and the main entrance sit in the overlap area
A directed surface and rows of trees in the same orthogonality create a harmonious environment
Extensive green areas lie directly on the border and traffic areas are largely shielded
The concrete slab carpet with rows of trees, seating and bicycle parking creates a distinctive space
It is both a central axis and a connecting space of high quality of stay
The entrance is accentuated with a staggered row of trees
A sequence of well-proportioned outdoor spaces is proposed
The precisely designed main square sits in the middle of the longitudinal path axis
Two new rows of trees enhance and hierarchise the outdoor space
The outdoor areas are mixed traffic zones usable for parking or as a lounge area
Parking spaces appear functional and accessible parking is possible at the main entrance
Bicycle parking is very well placed, centrally and easily visible
The concrete slab axis with transverse seepage joints is harmonious
Extensive flower meadows and multi-stemmed trees form a filter and ecologically valuable areas
The two-storey volume above ground appears reserved
The building has a differentiated opening behaviour in all facades
Its functions as school building and sports hall can be seen from outside
Public rooms on the ground floor and the separation of sport and design allow seamless coexistence
Autonomous evening and weekend use of the hall is easy to implement
The theory rooms can also be used for other school or neighbourhood events
The sports halls are practical, correctly planned and sufficiently naturally lit
The connection to the existing hall is possible with a ramp and stairs
Four storey-high trusses span hall and entrance without supports
The expressive static structure creates an idiosyncratic, unmistakable spatial atmosphere
The desired flexible floor plan of a modern school can be implemented
Room dimensions are standardised and can be used flexibly
The exhibition hall is the central meeting and resting place
Generous glazing and ceiling skylights ensure good daylight and zone the areas
Vertical wooden slats of different spacings structure the facade according to interior needs
The walls are planned as prefabricated wooden frame elements
The constructive concept is clear and understandable
System separation, energy, ecology and sustainability are credibly described
External sun protection prevents glare and summer overheating and photovoltaics are planned
Fire protection and escape route requirements are correctly planned and fully presented
An interdisciplinary, finely developed project showing a high level of design expertise
negative: The new building is relatively close to the southern and eastern borders
The beach volleyball field at the back of the embankment has no specific uses assigned nearby
The surface of the multifunctional space remains unclear
Not enough information is given about the selection of trees
The step at the main entrance is incomprehensible and cannot be implemented for accessibility
The access spaces appear extremely opulent and inappropriate to the importance of the building
The beam cross sections shown do not correspond to the dimensions actually required
The large trusses are also arranged on the facade although this is not statically necessary
The training of the main supports is very symbolic and judged to be complex
The generosity of the plans comes at the price of a space requirement far above average
This generates the highest construction and operating costs of all projects and misses the cost target
